constraints: Read-only except requested generated JSON. Declared guarded rules are not proof replays; report-score tiers do not certify raw bytes or relocation equality. Current hashes do not prove artifacts were built from those inputs. In-place exception fixups leave pre-fix objects unavailable and dependency freshness unresolved.
name: build-provenance
purpose: Account for actual Ninja compile transforms and ordered source-versus-extracted link inputs without claiming source correctness
usage: Run after configure and a completed build. Schema version 1. Exit 0 PASS means snapshot and query accounting only; exit 1 FAIL; exit 2 UNRESOLVED missing artifacts or dependencies.
